title: Measure handoff cost per restart class: warm cache, long pause, after compaction
body:
Outcome: handoff economics are measured per restart class — warm cache (successor within the cache TTL), long pause (cache expired) and restart after compaction — reporting tokens and cost to reach the first verified step and the facts the successor had to re-read; the report says when a fresh session costs more than continuing.
Evidence: operator intake 2026-11-02 (pasted digest, item 2, Relayvora pre-alpha, 1–2 runs per variant): a short-session handoff raised cost 73%; a long-session handoff cut context 71% at similar cost. Related: t-nmdd3wh, t-6kqjkmr, t-rperync, t-3karwrx.
